blocks.text: For over a decade, Federal Land’s Marco Polo Residences in Cebu has offered a tranquil living environment for residents seeking elevated city living. Located atop Nivel Hills, it is Cebu’s first branded residence, offering panoramic views of the city skyline and coastline. Its location directly beside Marco Polo Plaza Cebu also gives residents convenient access to the world-class hospitality and amenities of the landmark hotel. Beyond providing a home, Marco Polo Residences has established a lifestyle that brings the comforts of hotel living into daily routines. This distinctive proposition recently earned the development the Best Investment Property in Metro Cebu award […]...
